description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Sicamous is a budget hotel chain property situated in Sicamous, BC, a small lakeside town at the junction of the Trans-Canada Highway and Highway 97A often called the Houseboat Capital of Canada. It sits in the heart of the Shuswap region, which is traversed by several long-distance cycling routes including the Trans Canada Trail. As a nationally recognized brand property, it offers a predictable, accessible overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the interior of BC.
